status_at_freeze: Colosseum labels opened 2026-10-14T02:05Z and scored by the handover (primary GO/GO, cohort-7 comparator set NO-GO tier 1). During code review, before this plan, the registered contrasts were rescored with the team's max-t rule from the handover's MDP scores: primary still GO (log-loss lower bound +0.0003); this is reported, not chosen. The count of zero-draw OEH-B groups (42/360) was read from the pre-outcome OEH-B files; no loss by draw status had been computed.

analyses.A_rescore: registered primary 4 contrasts and the 18 comparator contrasts under the team rule (critical = 0.95 quantile of max_j (mean*_j - mean_j)/se_j with the original se; seeds 20261014 and 20261004 as in the handover), next to the handover's per-draw rule
analyses.B_xgboost_cf: adapted XGBoost-CF/18 and /108 exactly as published_survival_120_* (per learner, primary meta-training stratum, median imputation, 100 trees depth 3, seed 42); main post-hoc family = OEH vs {B2 matched, XGBoost-CF/18} x {IBS, LL}, team max-t, 10000 draws, seed 20261014; XGBoost-CF/108 reported as architecture control

C_block_factorial.value: v(S) = loss(B2) - loss(B2+S), per MDP, then Shapley over P/H/L; MDP bootstrap percentile 95%, descriptive; pooled, per learner, per family

D_decision.policy: smallest budget x_k with forecast P(E<=k) >= tau, otherwise skip
D_decision.cost: collect: x_k (+ lambda if E > k); skip: lambda if E < 6 else 0; oracle: x_E if E < 6 else 0; regret = cost - oracle
D_decision.aggregate: mean over rows within MDP, then over MDPs; OEH minus method per MDP, percentile 95% from 10000 MDP draws, seed 20261014

analyses.E_zero_draw: OEH-B groups whose posterior sampler accepted no draw: rows, label mix, OEH/B2 scores and probability of the true class, by family and draw status (descriptive)
analyses.F_cost: OEH-B runtime per MDP-behavior group against |S||A| for cohort 7, Colosseum (355/360 groups ran with multi-threaded OpenBLAS) and the two full-OEH BRIDGE panels

not_run: learning-curve extrapolation baseline (needs Colosseum curve features)
